11-zoomable-treemap.visual_critic_note: Deliberate HCL lightness hierarchy across three depth levels and a colorblind-safe palette show genuine design intent, but leaf labels at 9-10px render too small to read at the overview scale, keeping it short of polished.
11-zoomable-treemap.encoding_integrity_note: Treemap area encoding is mathematically correct via d3.treemap().sum(), domains are fully data-driven, but the composite key function (name+depth+parentName) is collision-prone and the shared rng() state between data generation and leaf coloring means colors would not be permutation-stable.
11-zoomable-treemap.stress_test_note: Click-based zoom (no drag/brush update storm), scales mutated in-place before transitions (no stale closure), .interrupt() called before each new transition (no mid-flight snap), pointer events used throughout (no mouse-touch fight), and no cross-view dispatch (no feedback loop risk).
11-zoomable-treemap.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with 8 well-chosen colorblind-safe hues and hierarchical lightness encoding manages complexity well; zoom-based progressive disclosure avoids overloading working memory, though the root-level overview buries most leaf labels in cells too small to label.
